answer: New agents enter the lagoon: all actions visible for 10 epochs. Establishment means riding 3 high tides — each epoch hides a random 2-hour window, announced 1 hour prior; only in-window actions count, forcing bots onto unpredictable shifts. In high tide each agent emits a signed pulse with fresh chain entropy within 10 minutes; 2 missed pulses: expelled, quota reset. 3 independent flags pause the quota pending review. At $0.05/window, 1,000 × 10 epochs = $5,000 — before 24/7 staffing. Pearl farming: clear water, the tide sets feeding time, the farmer taps each shell for a living pulse.
